description: This file defines an abstract base class 'RendererBase' used for rendering elements in the MigraDoc document processing library, specifically for RTF rendering. It includes methods for translating enumerations, units, and properties to RTF control words, as well as utility functions for rendering document elements.

classes.name: RendererBase
classes.description: An abstract base class for all RTF renderers in the MigraDoc library, providing utility methods for translating document object properties to RTF control words and rendering document elements.

methods.name: CollectionContainsObjectAssignableTo
methods.description: Checks if a collection contains an object assignable to any of the specified types.

methods.name: CreateEnumTranslationTable
methods.description: Initializes the static translation table mapping MigraDoc enums to RTF control words or values.

methods.name: ToRtfUnit
methods.description: Converts a Unit object to an integer value in specified RTF units.

methods.name: Translate
methods.description: Translates a document property value to an RTF control word, handling units, enums, booleans, and colors.

methods.name: TranslateBool
methods.description: Translates a boolean property to corresponding RTF control words.

methods.name: GetValueAsIntended
methods.description: Retrieves the property value, considering effective value if specified.

methods.name: RenderUnit
methods.description: Renders a Unit property as an RTF control with specified units.

methods.name: RenderTrailingParagraph
methods.description: Ensures the document ends with a paragraph if the last element isn't a paragraph.
